sentences.text:
Inter alia contends that none of the petitioners at any stage was a Director of the Company which allegedly had business transactions with the complainant leading to lodging of the FIR No.
307/2023 dated 17.08.2023 registered under Section 420/34 of IPC against the Company as well at its representatives.
He would further point out that, in any case, it is an outright civil dispute for alleged debt to be recovered from the Company/ its representatives qua which a civil suit has already been filed.
Learned ASC accepts notice on behalf of the State.

3. Let notice be issued to other respondents through all permissible modes, returnable on 18.11.2025.
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 11/08/2025 at 22:32:18 4.
At this stage, learned APP submits that there is no requirement of any custodial interrogation.

In that view of the matter, on a Court query to learned APP, he states under instructions of the I.O. that as regards the apprehension of the petitioners qua their arrest, the same is completely unfounded as one of them has already been examined and let off and likewise, he submits that the other Munish Sikka & Anr vs State (Nct Of Delhi) & Ors on 8 August, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/116076334/
1 petitioners can also join the investigation and his custody is also not required.
